title: save_dashboard

dashboardIdOrApiName.description: The id (0FK...) or apiName of the dashboard to save. Optional; defaults to the dashboard the batch targets.

description: Control operation. Standalone (sole operation in the batch): commits whatever draft is already staged on the dashboard. In a mixed batch: persists once after the other operations in that same batch succeed. The top-level autosave flag is ignored when save_dashboard is present.
